title: Zkbill
tagline:
- Add ZK to bill payment application. Hide information like amount and tax
- Deploy in polygon faucet
description:
Bill receipts have confidential information that cannot be added to public ledgers. This project creates a ZK application that will hide secret information and perform increment operation using ZK circuit.
